recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-32151 unless the work group later wants a purely editorial punctuation cleanup in the existing comment.
issue_request: FHIR-32151 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-core Questionnaire clarification asking that Questionnaire.item.required=true be clear for question items: a required question must have its own direct answer, not merely answered child questions, and a required group must have at least one descendant question with an answer.
initial_application: The Jira comment records application on the Questionnaire-fixes branch as git commit 2711b0a0d2. That commit added the requested direct-answer and required-group wording to source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml, and the current source preserves that wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists questionnaire=Questionnaire under [resources], so the checked Questionnaire StructureDefinition is in current build scope. The originating Zulip thread records Lloyd McKenzie confirming that a required question means it must have an answer and Paul Lynch filing FHIR-32151. Confluence minutes show candidate Persuasive SDC handling followed by a FHIR-I block vote listing FHIR-32151 as Persuasive. FHIR-26684 is earlier same-element context for parent/group required semantics, while FHIR-32665 is a separate QuestionnaireResponse cardinality issue from the same discussion neighborhood.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative current source already states that a required question must have a direct answer and that a required group must have at least one descendant question with an answer, so a source edit would be redundant editorial churn rather than a necessary spec correction.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive clarification for the same Questionnaire.item.required comment established parent/group required semantics retained around the FHIR-32151 wording.
Same Zulip thread later raised a separate QuestionnaireResponse answer cardinality issue; it was not needed to decide this seed.
